info.title: Coinmico API
info.summary: Crypto market data measured from real trades on 50+ exchanges and indexed on-chain.
info.description: Free, read-only REST API. Every request needs an API key from https://api.coinmico.com/dashboard sent as x-api-key or a bearer token. 600 requests per hour per key. Attribution "Data by Coinmico" is required.

get.description: Returns assets ordered by market cap. Each row is the same shape as the market table on coinmico.com: a volume-weighted price measured across the venues we track, 1h/24h/7d/30d change, measured 24h volume, circulating/total/max supply, ATH/ATL and a measured flag.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Ignored when offset is set.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated asset ids to fetch instead of the ranked list.

parameters.name: sparkline
parameters.description: Include a 7-day hourly price array per coin.

200.description: Ranked list of every asset in the index with price, market cap, volume, change and supply.

503.description: unavailable: Market data is temporarily unavailable; retry after a few seconds.
